eli: Heads-up: @redwood/sdk@2.1.0 export map change broke several onboarding samples that still use CJS require(). CI shows `SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module`.

tam: Do we have the package.json snippet that caused it?

eli: yeah, it was simplified to force ESM for edge runtimes: `"exports": { ".": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "./package.json": "./package.json" }`. That made require() resolve the mjs file on Node 14/16.

robin: Oof. Lots of tutorials and internal samples still use `const sdk = require('@redwood/sdk')`. We should never remove a CJS path without a compatibility plan.

eli: Also hit types: `types` was pointing to the esm d.ts and some TS consumers (tsc + older bundlers) failed to resolve typedefs when using `import sdk = require('@redwood/sdk')`.

ci-bot: CI failure: onboarding-samples#1041 (node 16)

tam: Short-term: publish a patch adding conditional exports with both `import` and `require` targets, set `main` to CJS, `module` to ESM, and point `types` to a flattened `dist/index.d.ts`. Example: `"exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }`

robin: Agreed. Also add a CI smoke test that runs our sample apps in require-mode (node 14/16) and import-mode (node 18+) plus an edge runtime check (bun/vercel). Add a small auth parity check too since some samples assume global fetch.

eli: I'll open DEVEX ticket and cut a quick 2.1.1 hotfix revert if needed, then ship 2.1.2 with dual entries and tests.

robin: Please add a changelog note mentioning CJS consumers and migration steps.

ci-bot: created ticket DEVEX-333: restore-cjs-and-add-smoke-tests

tam: Thanks all — good catch by CI.
